offering_description.value: AerSale sells aircraft, engines and parts to commercial fleet operators and leases aircraft and engines. Its divisions provide maintenance, engineering, asset management and teardowns across the aircraft lifecycle.

quotes.quote: AerSale specializes in the sale and lease of aircraft and engines while providing a range of MRO, PMA, and engineering services for commercial aircraft.

From component and airframe MRO to inventory, sales, asset management, and teardowns, AerSale connects every service you need—without the extra costs and headaches that come with managing multiple vendors. Our divisions work as one, eliminating inefficiencies, reducing turnaround times, and keeping your aftermarket strategy profitable, predictable, and ready for takeoff.
